findings.text: Equal full and selection ranges can cover an entire command: Lean 4.34.1 gives both ranges as `instance! 42` when that macro expands to an ordinary anonymous instance, so rule 3 drops the declaration and reports a `deriving instance` command that never existed. Fix: Check whether the range covers the complete defining command before reporting an unresolved class-name range.

The blanket omission rule conflicts with the prototype, which retains the `SelectPhase.all` mention from a reported `initFn` in `SqlSelectRule` with an empty `user_name`. Fix: Limit omission to relationships read from the reported constant’s environment facts and refer `.ilean` mentions to the range and empty-user rules.

Passing a version 4 fact reader produces `field macroScopes must be a boolean`, which gives no recovery action for the missing field. Fix: Tell the user to rebuild the fact reader and pass the rebuilt executable to `--reader`.

The quoted name has a range of its own, so the test still passes if parent selection reverts to rejecting every printed name containing `._@.`. Fix: Use `«x._@.y»` as the sole parent at the `initFn` range and assert that the helper folds into it.
The status lists two open limits, but the same commit also leaves open how to store a relationship whose target was reported. Fix: Add the reported-target decision to the status entry.
